To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

transient latchup phenomenon was found as the root of field lightning surge failure in High voltage BBJT based line driver for ADSL system and the protection margin was determined by the correlation between component level and system level surge injection test.
the root cause of damage in line driver is latch up phenomenon in BJT cell and that the field lightning surge damage can be reproduced with STD surge waveform in component level.
the surge made with input Tx output created junction break-down in amplifier, which is HVBJT, and caused current crowding in Vcc and Vee.
In summary, our research is concerned with
stress mechanism and failure analysis about line driver of ADS.
stress mechanism of field lightning surge in line driver and its failure mechanism, which could be reproduced in component and board level.
the root cause of failure in ADSL system caused by field lightning surge, which is one of the important issues for ADSL telecommunication system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the surge damage root was the same as that of component level.
the root of failure mechanism of line driver is the transient latchup in the HVBJT cell.
the surge level of line driver in ADSL system is 1.0kA (8/20μs) for positive pulse and 0.8kA (8μs) for negative pulse.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the surge damage mechanism of the High Voltage BJT line driver was clarified by RTESA and the protection margin was decided by the correlation between component level and system level.
, in order to protect line driver from lightning surge, it is necessary to set up protection circuit with clamping diodes, in addition to the existing protection circuit with Zener diode.
, in case of ADSL line driver, we could reproduce damages by surge injection, and we also found that surge damage root is latchup phenomenon.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have verified stress mechanism of field lightning surge and reproduced damages in High voltage BBJT based line driver of DSL system, and we have set up line driver surge protection margin.
we could reproduce damages in line driver and verify stress mechanism.
the line driver of ADSI telecommunication can be used in field lightning surge environment.
